original_text:
🎯 Just completed an Extreme SQL Challenge: Order Fulfillment (75 pts)!
 🧠 Simulated real-world inventory logic using window functions, running totals, and smart case handling — deciding if each order was ✅ Full, ⚠️ Partial, or ❌ Unfulfilled.
It felt like building a real warehouse system in SQL! 🏭📦
Grateful to Ankit Bansal sir 🙏 for such a powerful platform filled with hands-on, real-world problems. It's an amazing way to sharpen SQL skills! 💪💻
📊

interview_questions.question: How did the described SQL approach classify each order by fulfillment status?
interview_questions.answer:
The approach combined window functions and running totals with conditional case handling.
